title: File:Pick and Inhaler, Any Inahler.jpg
desc:
My nagging annoying mild asthma cough has gotten no better, maybe worse. so my Dr is upping the ammunition. That's Dulera on the left taken twice a day and Albuterol on the right,as needed when the hacking gets bad.
I hate having to take this stuff. But i hate this ongoing cough.
